propositions: Core commands across _commands/, _engine_support/, and _io/ use imperative argv parsing that duplicates grammar already needed for documentation, creating maintenance burden.

Runtime handlers in _dispatch_* must be refactored to invoke per-command S2a argparse factories wired onto Route.parser_factory references in _registry.py, eliminating parallel imperative parsing logic.
Each migrated command family must preserve its original unknown-token semantics (parse_known_args skip vs reject-with-exit-2) and global flag/end-of-options extraction order through the factory seam.

Parser factories must import no domain executors or optional dependencies, and real execution must resolve only the selected parser and handler, provable via construction-exclusion and dispatch-isolation tests.

Acceptance verified by held-out parity oracle (49 commands × 9 argv variants), zero unapproved behavior delta, all 817 interface tests passing, and each family revertable as one self-contained unit (parser module + _registry.py line + _dispatch_* switch).
